statements.text: Official historic-resource records and permit/rezoning records co-address at this requested Atlas depth. This is a prompt for investigation, not evidence that any listed action affects any listed historic resource. At least one source geometry is representatively indexed rather than point-exact.
17 biodiversity observation records from 2 source channels address to this ground. This is observation density, not species abundance or complete ecological inventory.

25 permit or rezoning records address to this ground. They record authorized or proposed change, not proof that construction or land-use change occurred. At least one polygon is indexed by a representative address; its preserved geometry may span other cells.

10 independent source channels address signals to this ground: atlanta-historic-buildings, atlanta-rezoning-cases, epa-echo, fdic-locations, fdic-sod, gbif-occurrences, inaturalist-observations, nps-national-register, osm-notes, wikipedia-geosearch.
9 unresolved OpenStreetMap Notes address to this ground. This is evidence of unresolved mapping claims, not evidence that the underlying claims are true.

51 officially recorded historic or commemorative resources address to this ground. This measures institutionalized memory in the connected registers, not everything a community considers historically important.
1 EPA-regulated facility addresses to this ground. The statement reports ECHO records and does not independently establish present harm.
FDIC Summary of Deposits reports $306,600,000 held across 2 branches addressed to this ground. This is reported deposit stock, not evidence that the money is invested locally.
42 Wikipedia-geocoded entities address to this ground at the requested depth. This measures encyclopedic representation, not population or intrinsic importance.
